local function grade(score)
    if type(score) ~= "number" or score < 0 or score > 100 then
        return nil, "score must be between 0 and 100"
    elseif score >= 90 then return "A"
    elseif score >= 80 then return "B"
    elseif score >= 70 then return "C"
    elseif score >= 60 then return "D"
    else return "F" end
end
